caption: The taut mat of a trampoline is slapped with a hand, and the mat ripples outward and shivers before going flat.

sa.check: A trampoline with its mat in view.
The mat ripples outward from the slap and shivers.
The mat is flat and taut before the slap.
The slap comes first; the rippling and then the flat mat follow.

pc.expect: The mat lies flat and still until the palm lands; the ripple starts at the point of the slap and only then.
pc.fail: The mat is already shivering before the hand arrives; or a ripple starts far from where the hand lands; or the hand slaps and the mat stays flat; or the mat shivers again after going flat with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The ripples travel outward from the slap point toward the springs and the shiver fades to a flat mat.
pc.fail: Ripples travel inward from the edge toward the slap point; or the shiver grows after the slap; or keeps the same strength for the whole clip; or the mat freezes rigid in a rippled shape.

pc.expect: The mat behaves as a stretched fabric: it dips under the palm and springs back; the springs and frame stay rigid.
pc.fail: The palm's dent stays after the hand lifts; or the mat tears; or the frame bends with the slap; or the mat sags like a loose sheet after springing back.

pc.expect: The frame and legs stay fixed on the ground; only the mat and springs move.
pc.fail: The frame rocks or jumps at the slap; or a leg lifts off the ground; or the frame slides across the ground.

pc.expect: One mat in one frame; the hand passes through nothing and the mat stays one sheet.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the mat; or the mat splits or a hole opens; or the frame or springs vanish; or the trampoline changes into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mat's colour, the spring cover and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The mat changes colour; or the spring cover changes pattern; or the ground or background changes.
